ewc_stat_categories: Mineral waste from construction and demolition
notes: Concrete, aggregates, bricks, asphalt and other mineral fractions from building and demolition
Mining and quarrying residues, tailings and red mud; use only for mineral waste not assignable to construction, soils or ashes and slags
Excavated soil, sediments and dredged material

ewc_stat_secondary_categories: Mineral wastes from waste treatment and stabilised wastes
notes: Fly ash, bottom ash and slags from combustion, incineration and other thermal processes, whatever the origin

ewc_stat_categories: Metal wastes, ferrous;Metal wastes, non-ferrous;Metal wastes, mixed ferrous and non-ferrous
notes: Ferrous and non-ferrous metals and scrap; critical elements named as the recovered material go to critical_raw_materials

ewc_stat_categories: Household and similar wastes;Mixed and undifferentiated materials
notes: Household, municipal solid and unsorted waste; sorting residues and refuse-derived fuel are secondary waste from treatment
Food waste from households, retail and catering; food-processing by-products of any origin go to biomass_agrifood
Green waste and plant residues not attributable to a specific crop or agri-food process
Animal manure and slurry
Wood, timber and wood-based products at end of life
Paper, cardboard and pulp residues
Fossil-based polymers and plastic products at end of life; excludes bioplastics
Glass and glass products at end of life

ewc_stat_secondary_categories: Sludges and liquid wastes from waste treatment
notes: Sewage sludge and industrial sludges, including solids separated from wastewater; excludes wastewater as a liquid stream
Rubber and end-of-life tyres
Textiles, clothing and fibres at end of life

ewc_stat_categories: Discarded equipment (except discarded vehicles and batteries and accumulators waste) (W08 except W081, W0841)
notes: Electronic waste and electrical appliances; photovoltaic panels are a separate family
End-of-life vehicles and their components; batteries are a separate family
All battery chemistries, including lithium-ion and electric vehicle batteries; an element recovered from them goes to critical_raw_materials

ewc_stat_categories: Chemical wastes;Spent solvents;Acid, alkaline or saline wastes;Waste containing PCB
notes: Chemical residues, solvents, acids, alkalis and PCB-containing waste
Mineral and synthetic used oils; excludes used cooking oil
Medical and biological waste
Crop residues, lignocellulosic biomass and food-processing by-products of plant or animal origin, including used cooking oil
Water, wastewater and liquid effluents; solids and sludges separated from them go to sludge
Carbon dioxide and other gas streams used or captured as resources
Critical or strategic elements named as the recovered material, such as rare earths, lithium, cobalt or phosphorus; the product that contains them goes to its own family
Bio-based and biodegradable polymers
Nanomaterials, ionic liquids, hydrogels and other synthesised functional materials; use only when no material-specific family applies
Fibre-reinforced composites, including wind turbine blades
Photovoltaic modules and panels at end of life
Coal, fossil fuels, biogas, hydrogen as fuel and other energy carriers
Packaging and packaging waste when the material is not stated or is mixed
Unspecific terms such as waste streams, raw materials or goods
Economic sectors, activities and abstract concepts extracted in the material slot
Specific material that fits no other family
